Name: (CP) Ladies of Pelican Town
Author: deleted56164987
Description:
been sorta busy with irl stuff and i haven't finished all of my projects, but i thought i'd upload this one.

currently, it only replaces the portraits and not the character sprites. i'm planning to update this soon.

alongside this, i'm planning to make them compatible with seasonal characters and romanceable mods, but don't hold your breath on that one.

this was being worked on alongside the other male npcs, but there's a shit ton more of them that it is of the women, so it'll take awhile. T_T

-----------------------------

just drop it into your mods folder, and make sure you don't have any other mod that might conflict with this one. if there's any bugs or visual glitches, please let me know.

-----------------------------

thank you so much for the endorsements and kind comments! i really appreciate it :]

Manifest.Name: Ladies of Pelican Town
